tap.name: Tap Together
tap.description: Tap the block with your partner, clear rounds, and earn points for shop upgrades.
rules: This game is only for couples with a linked partner in settings.
At the start of a round, both can tap immediately — no need to wait.
The next round starts when both finish their part (e.g. 15/15).
Each new round requires 3× more taps.
Points are awarded for each tap and for completing a round — round rewards grow with difficulty.
Spend points in the shop on tools that speed up progress.
Quad and mega tap unlock after round 5 — 15 boosted taps each (×4 and ×10).
The leaderboard ranks pairs by total taps.

play.tapBlockDoneAria: You already finished your part of the round

geo.name: Guess the Location
geo.description: Guess where the place is on the map and compete with other couples.
rules: This game is only for couples with a linked partner.
Before each round, both press Ready — then a 3-second countdown and one round starts.
Each round has a time limit — each partner places their own marker on the map.
The closer the marker to the real spot, the more points; both partners' scores are summed.
Each confirms only their own marker — two independent guesses per round.
Up to 5 locations per day; the limit resets the next day.
When all 200 locations are done, the pool starts over.
The leaderboard ranks pairs by total score across all rounds.

draw.name: Guess the Drawing
draw.description: One draws, the other guesses — like Gartic, but for your couple.
rules: This game is only for couples with a linked partner.
Before each round, both press Ready — then a 3-second countdown and start.
Artist and guesser swap each round.
90 seconds per round: one draws, the other can guess while drawing continues.
The faster you guess, the more points.
Up to 10 scored rounds per day count for the leaderboard — then play for fun.

quiz.name: Your Own Game
quiz.description: A game board with categories and questions — answer together and score points.
rules: This game is only for couples with a linked partner.
Before the board, both press Ready — then a 3-second countdown and start.
First turn is random between partners, then turns alternate.
On your turn, pick any cell: category and value. 30 seconds to answer.
Each player picks one of four options. The choice cannot be changed. Correct answers earn the cell value (100, 200, or 300).
If both are correct, points are summed. Played cells cannot be picked again.
Each day — 5 random categories and a new question set (15 cells).
After all questions, the board refreshes the next day.
The leaderboard ranks pairs by total score.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.lead: What couples say about chat, calendar, and games in Amorely.

anya.name: Anya
anya.quote: We've been together for two years. Before, our chats disappeared into a regular messenger. In Amorely it's just the two of us. The shared photo calendar is our favorite. Open a month and you instantly see how you've been living.

arseniy.name: Arseniy
arseniy.quote: I thought it would be another app we'd drop in a week. Now every evening it's questions of the day and our own game. Even when we're both tired, it takes 10 minutes and things feel warmer.

tanya.name: Tanya
tanya.quote: What matters to me is that the chat is closed. Not for friends, not for stories. Plus it's all free. We weren't waiting for a subscription to pop up on the third screen.

lesha.name: Lesha
lesha.quote: We live in the same city, but barely cross paths because of work. We drop daily photos, weekend plans, and sometimes just games. Like a shared notebook — only prettier.

andrey.name: Andrey
andrey.quote: It installs in a minute, even though it's not from the Play Store. One thing: save your secret phrase right away. We almost skipped that step.

free.question: Is Amorely completely free?
free.answer: Yes. Amorely is completely free to use — create an account, invite your partner, and enjoy chat, calendar, feed, games, and more with no paywall.

private.question: Is chat private?
private.answer: Yes. Couple chat uses end-to-end encryption so only the two of you can read your messages — not even Amorely.

partner.question: Do both partners need an account?
partner.answer: Yes. Each partner creates a free account, then one sends a partner request so you can share a private space together.

distance.question: Does Amorely work for long-distance couples?
distance.answer: Yes. Amorely is built for couples near or far — stay close with chat, a shared feed, daily questions, games, and a photo calendar across time zones.

features.question: What can we do in Amorely?
features.answer: You get encrypted chat, a shared photo feed, questions of the day, a shared pet, date ideas, days-together milestones, couple games, and a photo calendar.

devices.question: Do I need to install an app?
devices.answer: No install required. Amorely works in the browser on phone and desktop, and you can add it to your home screen as a PWA.
